name: Editor minimap, find Note by metadata, hierarchical recent Notes, latest Mermaid and better Windows UX
body: This **minor** [MindForger](https://www.mindforger.com/) release brings editor minimap, find Note by metadata, hierarchical recent Notes, associations colorized by score, Mermaid diagrams upgrade, beautiful Windows UX and revamped AUR package for Arch Linux. * **Editor** * Editor minimap - narrow strip on the right side of Note and Notebook editors shows the overview of the edited text in syntax highlighting colors w/ the visible part of the text marked - click it to jump. * Note and Notebook editor is wider than the Notebook outline shown next to it - the outline/editor ratio is newly 40%/60%. * Editor line numbers can be hidden in Preferences. * Light theme editor syntax highlighting newly uses vivid, high contrast colors (e.g. italic text was nearly black). * **Find and navigation** * Find Note by Metadata shows Notes in a table w/ name, size (text bytes), reads, writes, created and modified columns which can be used for sorting to find the biggest, oldest or most visited Notes. * Recent Notes view shows the history as a tree where consecutive Notes from the same Notebook are grouped under the Notebook. * Recent Notes view toggle to show Notes which were recently viewed or edited, or edited only. * Opened Notebook shelf shows the shelf name in the table header. * `Esc` leaves the command palette and gives focus to the next component in the view. * **Mind inspired features** * Associations panel bars are colored green/orange/red by the association score. * **HTML preview** * Mermaid diagrams upgraded from mermaid.js 7.1.0 to 12.2.0 - new diagram types (mindmap, timeline, gitGraph, quadrant, ...) and syntax newly work, diagrams follow dark/light HTML theme. * Note view shows Note tags under the Note title - aligned w/ Notebook description view which shows Notebook tags under the title. * **Windows** * Native theme newly uses the Windows palette: selected rows in Notebook/Note tables, outline tree, enabled status bar `ADLMSTW` diodes, ... * Native theme editor newly has VSCode light inspired Markdown syntax highlighting. * Editor font is never smaller than the application font (from Monospace to Consolas), UI newly follows Windows display scaling including fractional factors. * Application font (Notebook and Note names in tables and outline tree, command palette, `ADLMSTW` diodes, Note name and buttons in the editor, ...) is newly Windows UI font (Segoe UI 9pt like menu) - it used to be smaller and it was tiny when MindForger was started after display scaling had been changed (e.g. 100% > 300% on 4K) without signing out. * **Distributions** * Arch Linux - upstream reference PKGBUILD for the [AUR mindforger](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/mindforger) package (Qt WebKit) is newly maintained in `build/arch/` and verified in an Arch Linux Docker container. * MindForger can be built w/ CMake 4 (e.g. on Arch Linux) - the bundled cmark-gfm newly requires CMake 3.5 and all maintained build scripts pass CMake 4 compatibility. * **Fixes** * Menu and main toolbar icons are newly darkened on light menus/toolbar (native and light themes) on Windows, Linux and macOS to be readable. * Blurry menu and toolbar icons on Linux and macOS HiDPI displays (4K, Retina, scaling set by `QT_SCALE_FACTOR`) - icons are rendered in device pixels. * Native theme on Linux and macOS (light mode) had no editor syntax highlighting - it newly follows OS light/dark palette. * macOS native dark theme colors todo tasks in the editor (previously they were black, i.e. invisible) and in progress tasks are orange. * Editor syntax highlighting no longer shows underscores inside words (e.g. `this_is_function_name_`) as italic, and bold requires non-whitespace before the closing `*` (e.g. `aaa *bbb * ccc` is not bold). * Find Notebook by Name (`Ctrl-Shift-B`) finds only Notebooks which are on the shelf when a Notebook shelf is opened. --- [Ubuntu PPA](https://launchpad.net/~ultradvorka/+archive/ubuntu/productivity/+packages) | [Debian PPA](http://mindforger.com/debian-ppa/) | [Fedora COPR](https://copr.fedorainfracloud.org/coprs/dvorka/mindforger/) | [Windows nightly builds](https://ci.appveyor.com/project/dvorka/mindforger/build/artifacts) [![Download MindForger](https://a.fsdn.com/con/app/sf-download-button)](https://sourceforge.net/projects/mindforger/files/2.6.0/)
